_comment: The opt-in attachment of the diagnostics report: today's complete log, redacted line by line by redaction.json, saved next to the report for the user to attach by hand (nothing is uploaded by the product). max_bytes is the refusal cap, applied to the log file and again to the redacted text; over it nothing is attached. The preview the page shows is the first preview_head_lines and the last preview_tail_lines redacted lines, each cut to preview_line_max_chars characters. Implemented by _shared/lua/diagnostics/day_log.lua and windows/infra/day_log.ahk, both replaying _shared/tests/corpus/diagnostics/day_log_vectors.json.
